purpose: Machine-readable map of the signed G5 evidence bundle for protocol bandroom-d2-cloud-recovery-v1, route A. Structure mirrors analysis/scripts/verify_cloud_release.py and verify_release.py. This is a schema, not evidence.

authority.effectiveFiles: verify_cloud_release.FILES = baseline - 6 files + 6 files = 32 regular files

bundle.signatureFiles: <role>.sig per role, detached over the exact manifest.json bytes, not listed in manifest.files
bundle.trustFileLocation: outside the bundle (allowed-signers: '<role> ssh-ed25519 <base64>' per line)
bundle.outputManifest: checkpoint-7.json (server checkpoint index/outputIndex 7; older notes call it checkpoint-2.json)

manifest.sourceTreeSha: 40 lowercase hex; candidate HEAD tree or release HEAD^{tree}
manifest.files: map filename -> 64 lowercase hex; must be exactly FILES union acoustic chunks

releaseGuard.role: Separate release-entry check; not part of the signed 32-file bundle and not a substitute for verify_cloud_release.py.

releaseGates.note: release-gates.json is the guard input; the signed bundle carries gates.json. Both must say eligible/passed, but they are different files with different paths.

acousticChunks.hashBinding: manifest.files[acoustic-NN.bin] equals the transfer-chunk SHA at that plan index
acousticChunks.format: bandroom-acoustic transfer chunk: 4-byte big-endian header length + canonical JSON header + raw payload; read_chunk() validates digest, identity and predecessor
acousticChunks.fileCountFormula: 32 regular files + N acoustic chunks + manifest.json + 4 role signatures

offline.runs: exactly 3, step order ['A','B','C']; each carries officialRunId, fence, startedAt, endedAt, automationId, taskId plus SUBJECT and CANDIDATE fields; offline.isolated must be true and every run.automationId must equal history.automationId
offline.coldRunId: run D officialRunId; must differ from all three runs and appear as the fourth history record
offline.auditRows: one site event type=offline_run per A/B/C with automationId and isolated=true; filtered out of site-event-export.json
offline.note: fairness is embedded in offline.json per M5

officialRunHistory.runs: four records: A/B/C plus the read-only cold reference D; fields officialRunId, startedAt, endedAt, automationId, taskId, officialRecordRef, source='scheduled-cloud', clientExecution=false, approvalPrompts=0, quotaObservation; 0 < duration <= 900 s; runs non-overlapping
officialRunHistory.emptyQueueWakes: >=3 distinct officialRunId not in runs; derived from read_qa_site_events rows with kind='wake', pendingCount=0, pendingAcoustics=0, subscriptionActive=true, emptyQueueAccepted=true, mapped to platform records by at; fields officialRecordRef, automationId, source='scheduled-cloud', clientExecution=false, approvalPrompts=0, discoveredCount=0, createdCount=0, startedAt; span >= 86400 s. kind='drain_qa_queue' rows are excluded.
officialRunHistory.note: A/B/C official platform refs (userTurnId/assistantMessageId/turnKey) ride here or in officialRecordRef; server runId/fence remain in offline/executor exports

siteEventExport.events: exactly 11 cloud events and only the 9 G5 types; per run: A [claimed,retry_wait], B [claimed,recording_verified,checkpoint_saved,interrupted], C [claimed,checkpoint_restored,suffix_completed,feedback_committed,receipt_readback]. offline_run, wake and drain_qa_queue rows from read_qa_site_events MUST be filtered out.
siteEventExport.source: read_qa_site_events (owner-only) with type/officialRunId filters; record_qa_run_event writes the rows idempotently per (owner,officialRunId,type,fence)

siteEventRaw.note: detail is flattened into the row by the server. Keep this raw export in the run directory; the signed site-event-export.json is the filtered 11-row view.

executorEventExport.runs: exactly 3: B, C, cold D. Each executionId unique, officialRunId, TASK+ (fence for B/C), source='cloud-executor', localExecution=false, startedAt/endedAt inside the official run
executorEventExport.note: Run D is the fourth official run; do not reuse C's runId for the cold executor row

runD.officialRunId: distinct from A/B/C; becomes offline.coldRunId and recovery.coldRunId
runD.serverLease: none; no claim/retry/checkpoint/feedback. fence is null in the run evidence; the official record still carries automationId/taskId/times
runD.siteEvent: one offline_run audit row with automationId/isolated=true; no cloud event types

acousticPlan.chunk: 4-byte big-endian header length + canonical JSON header {format,chunkIndex,previousSha256,decodeSha256,bundleSha256,configSha256,featuresSha256} + raw little-endian float32 frames
acousticPlan.configSha256: sha256(canonical analysis-config.json.acousticConfig), not the file digest
acousticPlan.persistence: B writes plan chunks 0..5 and plan-b.json under /mnt/data/bandroom-g5/acoustic-plan; C verifies those exact bytes and computes 6..9. Missing prefix in C is a blocker, not a recompute.
acousticPlan.stageHashes: AcousticStore.manifest hashes raw-payload SHA/bytes; resumed/manifest.files/executor lists use transfer-blob SHA
acousticPlan.prohibition: v26 prefix parts (6 x 20,996 B) are a different plan and MUST NOT be renamed acoustic-NN.bin

acousticRecovery.basis: verifier plan windows(decoded.sample_count); v26 6-part prefix is separate G3 evidence
acousticRecovery.resumed: array of 1..24 verifier-plan transfer-chunk digests; length N defines acoustic-NN.bin count
acousticRecovery.prefix: strict prefix of resumed; 0 < len(prefix) < len(resumed); cut = len(prefix) = 6 (B persists 0..5, C restores and computes 6..9)
acousticRecovery.cold: byte-identical chunk list to resumed, produced by run D
acousticRecovery.coldRunId: run D officialRunId, distinct from A/B/C
acousticRecovery.coldStageIndexSha256: sha256 of canonical {format:'bandroom-acoustic-features-v1', identity, plan, chunks, nextChunk} where chunks carry RAW payload SHA/bytes; transfer-blob SHA is used only by resumed/manifest.files/executor lists

shape.offlineCheckpoint: binary decode/feature checkpoint accepted by bandroom_acoustic.checkpoint.read_checkpoint(input_sha256, artifact_sha256, analysis_version)

offlineOutput.binding: offline-output.json and offline-cold-output.json must have equal manifest hashes and equal executor outputSha256

browserAcceptance.binding: same SUBJECT as offline; feedbackId/receiptId equal offline.feedbackReceipt; learnerBaselineBefore/After equal and contain PRESERVED keys; rollbackVerified=true
browserAcceptance.cases: all 10 BROWSER_CASES plus slow-loadedmetadata, repeat-marker, pause, reopen; each status='passed' with non-empty receipt

Chrome.binding: SUBJECT + feedbackId + receiptId + Chrome version + error identity

browserPlaybackEvents.events: mediaTimeMs within [0,durationMs], elapsedMs integer nondecreasing, loadedmetadata.elapsedMs <= seeked.elapsedMs
browserPlaybackEvents.timelineChecks: exactly 2: (Chrome,'mp4/aac') and (Chrome,'webm/opus'); distinct recordingSha256, duration 30000..180000 ms, markers first/middle/tail

platformProbe.probes: exactly 4: {webm/opus, mp4/aac} x {short 30-45 s, near-limit 165-180 s}; each readRun/resumeRun present in official history

runtimeProfile.coldTrials: >=3 per encoding mp4/aac and webm/opus; distinct officialRunId; cacheEmpty=true; durationMs 165000..180000; stageSeconds keys exactly download,prepare,decode,asr,acoustic,candidates,validate,writeback; download+prepare<=300 s; total<=executionSeconds<=900 s; coldBytes<=300000000; processTreePeakBytes<=8000000000
runtimeProfile.note: 300 s download+prepare is unreachable at measured v26 throughput (M4); this remains an owner-approved §4.3 revision dependency, not something to fake

gates.note: gates may only say passed after the corresponding evidence exists; the signature step is not independent proof

shape.runtimeBundle: zip <= 300000000 B containing cloud-stage.json index (<=1048576 B) and graphs/encoder-int8.onnx, graphs/probe-head.onnx whose digests match analysis-config.acousticConfig and the frozen model SHAs

adjudicated.clips: must contain the offline holdoutClipId with audioSha256=offline.recordingSha256, sampleRateHz=16000, sampleCount=decoded.sample_count

referenceWords.clips: matching clipId with words[wordIndex].word for each adjudicated error

validationOrder: 2. manifest identity + exact file inventory + acoustic chunk count
7. verify_work(offline, history, site, executor, recovery): A/B/C events, retry_wait, interrupted, lost receipt, fairness, emptyQueueWakes, and a distinct Run D cold record (coldRunId not in A/B/C)

integrationRisks.detail: verify_work does require recovery.coldRunId to be an official run distinct from A/B/C with its own history and cloud-executor record. Resolution: add a fourth read-only cold reference run D (RUN_D_COLD_PROMPT.txt) that performs no claim/retry/checkpoint/feedback, records its own officialRunId, and emits verifier-plan cold chunks. C's in-run cold remains the §4C hard gate. Never reuse C's runId as coldRunId.

verify_acoustic derives plan = list(windows(sample_count)) with PASS_OFFSETS=(0,400), FRAMES_PER_WINDOW=800, CONTEXT_FRAMES=100 (10 chunks for the HJK 3434-frame timeline). B now persists verifier-plan chunks 0..5 under /mnt/data/bandroom-g5/acoustic-plan; C restores and verifies them, computes 6..9, and reports plan lists in executor/checkpoint events; the 6-part 120/80 ms v26 prefix remains for G3 resume. The release verifier is unchanged. export_g5_evidence.py recomputes/validates the plan and stage hashes (raw-payload SHA for AcousticStore.manifest, transfer-blob SHA for resumed/manifest.files). test_r2_acoustic_plan.py runs the real verify_acoustic: positive exported bundle accepted, corrupted chunk / wrong suffix / wrong stage index rejected.
integrationRisks.evidence: run-side/test_r2_acoustic_plan.py: 9/9 checks pass; plan equality with acoustic_stage.windows(1,099,196) = 10 chunks

integrationRisks.detail: verify_offline_output requires analysis.errors with wordIndex/phoneIndex/kind and coverage over the full sample range, matching adjudicated human errors. A transport diagnostic manifest has no word-level errors. offline-output.json/offline-cold-output.json therefore come from G1/G2 artifacts, not from G3. G5 is blocked on G1/G2 for this file, but G3 itself is not invalid.

Agent 1 added append-only qa_site_events with owner-only record_qa_run_event (idempotent per owner/officialRunId/type/fence; recording_verified requires bytes+sha256; offline_run requires automationId+isolated=true) and read_qa_site_events (kind/type/official run/fence/automationId/isolated/bytes/sha256/stage/detail/source/pending/subscription/emptyQueueAccepted). A/B/C prompts now call record_qa_run_event; export_g5_evidence.py filters the raw export to exactly 11 cloud events and derives emptyQueueWakes from kind=wake rows, excluding offline_run and drain_qa_queue.
F2/F3-F5/F6 primary cloud JSON files were not byte-verified locally (m9). Only Work readbacks with local SHA verification are authoritative until bytes are recovered.

runtime-profile requires download+prepare <= 300 s with coldBytes <= 300 MB. Measured 4.044 MiB/min makes the 48.1 MiB int8 model alone exceed 300 s. Requires the owner-approved evidence-based §4.3 revision (D1); never write a passing value that was not measured.
